name.en: Google for Startups Accelerator: Korea (AI First)

aka: Google for Startups Accelerator AI First Korea

strategy.thesis: Equity-free, AI-focused accelerator for Korean seed-to-Series A startups building AI/ML-driven platforms and products, pairing founders with Google experts to solve technical challenges.

summary.en: Google for Startups Accelerator: Korea is a 10-week, equity-free, AI-focused accelerator for Korean seed-to-Series A startups; cohorts of 10–15 receive up to $350,000 in Google Cloud credits, expert mentoring and a Demo Day (2026 program runs Apr–Jul).
summary.local: 구글 포 스타트업 액셀러레이터: 코리아는 한국 시드~시리즈A AI 스타트업을 위한 10주 무지분 액셀러레이터로, 10~15개 기업이 최대 35만 달러의 구글 클라우드 크레딧과 멘토링을 받는다.

strategy.thesis: Seoul's first dedicated biotech/pharma startup support center, operated by KIST and Korea University under Seoul Metropolitan Government, for drug discovery, medical devices and digital health.

program.eligibility: Early-stage life-science startups (drug, medical devices, digital health)

application.how_to_apply: Resident-company and program recruitment via seoulbiohub.kr

summary.en: Seoul Bio Hub, opened in October 2017 as Korea's first dedicated biotech/pharma startup support center (operated by KIST and Korea University for the Seoul Metropolitan Government), hosted about 130 startups by 2023 across drug discovery, medical devices and digital health, providing wet labs, shared equipment and global acceleration such as BIO USA support.
summary.local: 서울바이오허브는 2017년 10월 개관한 국내 최초의 바이오·제약 창업 지원 센터로, 한국과학기술연구원(KIST)과 고려대학교가 서울시를 위해 운영하며 의약·의료기기·디지털헬스 분야 초기 기업에 웻랩과 공유장비, 해외 진출(BIO USA) 등을 지원한다.

strategy.thesis: Leading Korean Web3/blockchain venture fund and ecosystem builder; incubates early Web3 startups through subsidiaries (e.g. UNOPND) and co-hosts Korea Blockchain Week.

summary.en: Hashed, founded in 2017 by Simon Kim, is Korea's leading Web3/blockchain venture fund and ecosystem builder; it raised a KRW 240 billion (~US$204M) Venture Fund II in 2021, incubates early Web3 startups via subsidiaries such as UNOPND, and co-hosts Korea Blockchain Week.
summary.local: 해시드는 2017년 김서준 대표가 설립한 국내 대표 Web3·블록체인 벤처 펀드이자 생태계 빌더로, 2021년 2,400억 원(약 2억 400만 달러) 규모의 2호 펀드를 결성했고 UNOPND 등 자회사를 통해 초기 Web3 스타트업을 인큐베이팅한다.
